name: Shops at Northgate Village
summary: Northgate Village is a community-focused shopping center in Tracy, California, serving over 215,600 residents with exceptional Interstate 205 visibility. The recently expanded center offers a diverse mix of coworking spaces, dining, youth activities, and community services with ample parking and flexible zoning.
demographics: Northgate Village serves a diverse trade area of over 215,600 residents in Tracy, California, the second largest city in San Joaquin County. The center attracts a mix of working families and commuters who travel between the Central Valley and San Francisco Bay Area, representing middle-income households seeking convenient services and amenities. The tenant mix of coworking spaces, dining options, youth activities, and churches indicates a family-oriented demographic with varied lifestyle needs and a preference for community-focused services.
description: Northgate Village is a dynamic community shopping center located at 1005 East Pescadero Avenue in Tracy, California, strategically positioned just south of Highway 205 and MacArthur Drive. With exceptional visibility from Interstate 205, the center benefits from significant commuter traffic flowing between the Central Valley and the San Francisco Bay Area, serving a robust trade area of over 215,600 residents. The property has recently undergone exciting expansions, transforming it into a versatile destination that hosts a diverse array of businesses including coworking spaces, dining establishments, youth activity centers, and churches. The center's flexible zoning and ample parking make it an attractive location for both tenants and visitors, while its position in San Joaquin County's second-largest city ensures consistent foot traffic and community engagement. Managed by Tim Moody, CSM, Northgate Village represents a commitment to lifting properties and elevating standards in the Tracy retail market.
